caption: The drawing displays a detailed grayscale illustration of a teapot with a bulbous, segmented body, a curved spout to the left, and an ornate handle to the right, all resting on a broad, round base with decorative patterning on the foot and lid. The lid is topped with a small finial resembling a fruit or flower motif. Above and to the left of the teapot, there is a close-up view of a floral design element, possibly used on the teapot itself. In the lower left corner is a technical drawing of the teapot in outline, labeled with dimensions (12" in height, 11-1/16" in width), while in the lower right corner is a horizontal band featuring a repeating decorative pattern, accompanied by a measuring scale. The composition is set against a plain background with all objects rendered in fine black and gray tones, giving the image a monochromatic appearance.
title: Silver Teapot
